records.name: HarmActionsEval
records.focus: Safety of autonomous agents operating with powerful toolsets.
records.focusZh: 评估拥有高权限工具集的自主智能体是否会执行有害操作。
records.verificationNote: The official HarmActionsEval page publishes a model leaderboard using SafeActions@1 and labels the snapshot as updated in March 2026.

records.name: TrustLLM — Safety
records.focus: Trustworthiness evaluation across jailbreak, toxicity, misuse, and exaggerated-safety dimensions.
records.focusZh: 从越狱、毒性、滥用和过度安全等维度评估大语言模型可信性。
records.verificationNote: The official TrustLLM leaderboard reports several safety metrics. This card ranks only the published Jailbreak metric, where the page states that higher values are better.

records.name: TrustLLM — Fairness
records.focus: Fairness evaluation covering stereotype recognition, agreement, disparagement, and preference behavior.
records.focusZh: 覆盖刻板印象识别、赞同倾向、贬损行为与偏好表现的公平性评估。
records.verificationNote: The official TrustLLM leaderboard publishes multiple fairness metrics rather than one composite score. This card ranks only Stereotype Recognition, where higher values are better.

records.name: DecodingTrust
records.focus: Trustworthiness evaluation across eight dimensions, including toxicity, privacy, robustness, and fairness.
records.focusZh: 从毒性、隐私、鲁棒性、公平性等八个维度评估大语言模型可信性。
records.verificationNote: Name, year, and project links were supplied by the OpenTAI team. The official repository describes eight trustworthiness dimensions. The leaderboard renders the CSV Average column as Overall and sorts it descending; the top three values are reproduced without changing model names. Source checked 2026-09-13: https://decodingtrust.github.io/leaderboard/static/csv/leaderboard.csv

records.name: SALAD-Bench
records.focus: Hierarchical safety evaluation of large language models, attack methods, and defense methods.
records.focusZh: 通过分层分类体系评估大语言模型及其攻击、防御方法的安全性。
records.verificationNote: Name, year, and project links were supplied by the OpenTAI team and checked against the official repository. Scores are the total column of the c1-base sheet in the official Space file/leaderboard.xlsx. The Space app.py sorts total descending and rounds to two decimals. This snapshot uses the base set only; attack-enhanced and multiple-choice results are separate. Source checked 2026-09-13: https://huggingface.co/spaces/OpenSafetyLab/Salad-Bench-Leaderboard/blob/main/app.py

records.name: JailbreakBench
records.focus: Standardized evaluation of jailbreak attacks and defenses for large language models.
records.focusZh: 采用标准化框架评估大语言模型的越狱攻击与防御。
records.metricZh: PAIR 对 Vicuna-13B 的攻击成功率 ↓
records.verificationNote: Name, year, and project links were supplied by the OpenTAI team and checked against the official project. This card compares defenses only for PAIR against Vicuna-13B under black-box access (34 average queries), using the official open-source table. Lower attack success rate is better for defenses; both 0% entries share rank 1. Other attacks and target models are separate evaluations. The source dates these PAIR rows 12 Oct 2023; 2024 is the benchmark publication year. Source checked 2026-09-13: https://jailbreakbench.github.io/tables/table_open_source.html

records.name: ForesightSafety-Bench
records.focus: LLM safety evaluation across fundamental, extended, and industrial safety risks.
records.focusZh: 覆盖基础安全、拓展安全与产业安全风险的大语言模型安全评估。
records.verificationNote: Name, year, and project links were supplied by the OpenTAI team and checked against the official repository. Overall Average follows the official leaderboard calculation: average pillar scores within each of Fundamental, Extended, and Industrial Safety for both default and attack assessments, then average the six non-null group means. Lower is safer. Values are displayed to two decimals with a percent sign, as on the official page. Source checked 2026-09-13. Official API sources: https://foresightsafety-bench.beijing-aisi.ac.cn/api/model_scores?source=default ; https://foresightsafety-bench.beijing-aisi.ac.cn/api/model_scores?source=attack ; https://foresightsafety-bench.beijing-aisi.ac.cn/api/pillars ; https://foresightsafety-bench.beijing-aisi.ac.cn/api/models

records.name: ThaiSafetyBench
records.focus: Safety evaluation of large language models in Thai language and cultural contexts.
records.focusZh: 评估大语言模型在泰语及泰国文化语境下的安全性。
records.verificationNote: Name, year, and project links were supplied by the OpenTAI team. The repository identifies Thai-language and cultural safety evaluation. The official Hugging Face Space dataframe labels the metric Overall ASR with a downward arrow; the three lowest published values are reproduced. Source checked 2026-09-13: https://typhoon-ai-thaisafetybench-leaderboard.hf.space/config

records.name: SafeBench
records.focus: Safety evaluation of autonomous driving algorithms across safety, functionality, and etiquette.
records.focusZh: 从安全性、功能性与驾驶礼仪三个层面评估自动驾驶算法。
records.verificationNote: Name, year, and project links were supplied by the OpenTAI team and checked against the official repository. This is the autonomous-driving SafeBench. Results use only the Overall Leaderboard OS column (higher is better), sorted descending across algorithm/state-space pairs. Scenario-specific tables are separate. State-space labels are retained to distinguish configurations. Source checked 2026-09-13: https://safebench.github.io/leaderboard/index.html
